metadata.framework: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (SI-7, SC-12, SC-13) / NIST FIPS 140-3

findings.description: PyCrypto has been unmaintained since 2013, contains unpatched vulnerabilities, and is not FIPS 140-3 validated.
findings.remediation: Migrate all cryptographic operations to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography >= 41.0.0) linked against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider.
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

findings.description: Detected version '38.0.1' is below baseline minimum '41.0.0'.
findings.remediation: Ensure version >= 41.0.0 (Rust memory-safety bindings) and verify dynamic linkage against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider rather than default static PyPI wheels.
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
